verses.en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.pt: Deus é o nosso refúgio e fortaleza, socorro bem presente na angústia.
verses.en_web: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. Of the sons of Korah; put to Alamoth. A Song.> God is our harbour and our strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.en: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.pt: Pelo que não temeremos, ainda que a terra se mude, e ainda que os montes se projetem para o meio dos mares;
verses.en_web: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
verses.en_bbe: For this cause we will have no fear, even though the earth is changed, and though the mountains are moved in the heart of the sea;

verses.en: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
verses.pt: ainda que as águas rujam e espumem, ainda que os montes se abalem pela sua braveza.
verses.en_web: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Though its waters are sounding and troubled, and though the mountains are shaking with their violent motion. (Selah.)

verses.en: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
verses.pt: Há um rio cujas correntes alegram a cidade de Deus, o lugar santo das moradas do Altíssimo.
verses.en_web: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
verses.en_bbe: There is a river whose streams make glad the resting-place of God, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

verses.en: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
verses.pt: Deus está no meio dela; não será abalada; Deus a ajudará desde o raiar da alva.
verses.en_web: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
verses.en_bbe: God has taken his place in her; she will not be moved: he will come to her help at the dawn of morning.

verses.en: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.pt: Bramam nações, reinos se abalam; ele levanta a sua voz, e a terra se derrete.
verses.en_web: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice, and the earth melted.
verses.en_bbe: The nations were angry, the kingdoms were moved; at the sound of his voice the earth became like wax.

verses.en: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.pt: O Senhor dos exércitos está conosco; o Deus de Jacó é o nosso refúgio.
verses.en_web: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord of armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our high tower. (Selah.)

verses.en: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
verses.pt: Vinde contemplai as obras do Senhor, as desolações que tem feito na terra.
verses.en_web: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Come, see the works of the Lord, the destruction which he has made in the earth.

verses.en: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
verses.pt: Ele faz cessar as guerras até os confins da terra; quebra o arco e corta a lança; queima os carros no fogo.
verses.en_web: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
verses.en_bbe: He puts an end to wars over all the earth; by him the bow is broken, and the spear cut in two, and the carriage burned in the fire.

verses.en: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.pt: Aquietai-vos, e sabei que eu sou Deus; sou exaltado entre as nações, sou exaltado na terra.
verses.en_web: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: Be at peace in the knowledge that I am God: I will be lifted up among the nations, I will be honoured through all the earth.

verses.en: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.pt: O Senhor dos exércitos está conosco; o Deus de Jacó é o nosso refúgio.
verses.en_web: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord of armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our high tower. (Selah.)
